name: githippo
description: Long-term memory for Claude, stored as Markdown in a git repo you own.
long_description: githippo gives Claude a long-term memory that lives in plain Markdown files in a local git repository you own: semantic and keyword recall in any language, a knowledge graph of people and projects, automatic de-duplication, history and time travel through git, and a guard that keeps secrets and ID numbers out of memory. Uses the same vault as the githippo CLI and Claude Code hooks. No account, no cloud.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Search memory by meaning and keywords, in any language

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save a durable fact; auto-filed, deduplicated and linked

tools.name: graph
tools.description: Relations between people, projects and decisions

tools.name: history
tools.description: How a memory changed, or what it said on a past date

tools.name: checkpoint
tools.description: Save or resume working state across context compaction

tools.name: maintain
tools.description: Find duplicates, contradictions and stale facts

tools.name: files
tools.description: Read and edit the Markdown memory files directly

vault_dir.description: Where your memory lives (a git repo of Markdown files). Shared with the githippo CLI and Claude Code.
